race.title: Blackmores Build Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Olly Murphy looks to hold the aces in this novice and, seemingly the choice of Sean Bowen, TAP TAP SHAMIE earns the vote to double his tally sporting a first-time hood. His stablemate Lirion was given a considerate introduction to hurdling back in the spring and he heads up the opposition with significant improvement on the cards. Hurdling debutants Ink Black Heart and Not Without Danger can fight out minor honours. TAP TAP SHAMIE (IRE) LIRION (FR) INK BLACK HEART
race.bettingForecast: Tap Tap Shamie (5/2), Ink Black Heart (3/1), Lirion (9/2), Not Without Danger (13/2), Golden Sanjida (12/1), Bourbon Floridhe (12/1), Ideal du Gazeau (16/1), Mighty Rhythm (16/1), Mr Winter (20/1), Right Royal Rascal (25/1), Tottie's Moon (33/1)

runners.name: TAP TAP SHAMIE

past_results.ride_description: Wore hood to post, midfield, hit 2nd, closed on leaders and came near side 2 out, every chance when ridden after last, short of room and impeded after last, not pace of leading trio towards finish
Wore hood to start, led, headed on bend before 5th, led again before 6th, went clear with one other rival after 3 out, asserted to go clear alone before last, won in a canter
Wore hood to post, held up in behind leaders, going well 2 out, went second before last, soon clear with leader, ridden along and made no impression flat, ran on same pace
Soon raced in second, led 2 out, shaken up and joined last, headed final 110yds, no extra towards finish
